summary_en: 400,000 shares (2.98% of outstanding) with ¥3.0B upper limit. Acquisition period 15 Jun–30 Nov 2026 via open-market purchase on TSE. Stated reason: enhanced shareholder returns and responsive capital policy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Hioki E.E. Corporation resolved on 5 June 2026 to acquire up to 400,000 treasury shares (2.98% of the 13.4 million shares outstanding, excluding treasury) with a ¥3.0 billion upper limit. The shares will be purchased via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 15 June to 30 November 2026. Management stated the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and enable responsive capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 618,913 treasury shares against an issued capital of 14.0 million shares.
